name: 🦒 动物园
desc: 欢迎语·喂食时间·参观规则·导览路线·动物馆区·闭园·门票·纪念品店

items.en: Welcome to the city zoo.
items.zh: 欢迎来到城市动物园。

items.en: The penguins are being fed now.
items.zh: 企鹅现在正在喂食。

items.en: Please do not feed the animals.
items.zh: 请不要给动物喂食。

items.en: The reptile house is straight ahead.
items.zh: 爬行动物馆就在正前方。

items.en: Flash photography is not allowed here.
items.zh: 这里不允许使用闪光灯拍照。

items.en: The zoo closes at six tonight.
items.zh: 动物园今晚六点闭园。

items.en: Tickets are sold at the entrance.
items.zh: 门票在入口处出售。

items.en: Please do not feed the animals by hand.
items.zh: 请不要用手给动物喂食。

items.en: The reptile house is just past the café.
items.zh: 爬行动物馆就在咖啡馆过去一点。

items.en: The guided tour starts near the main gate.
items.zh: 导览团在正门附近出发。

items.en: The elephants are fed twice on most afternoons.
items.zh: 大象在大多数下午都喂食两次。

items.en: The gift shop stays open until closing time.
items.zh: 纪念品店一直营业到闭园时间。

items.en: Please keep your ticket for re-entry to the zoo.
items.zh: 请保管好门票以便重新进入动物园。

items.en: The bird aviary is closed for cleaning this morning.
items.zh: 鸟舍今天上午因清洁关闭。

items.en: If you arrive before noon, you can watch the sea lions being trained.
items.zh: 如果中午前到达，你可以观看海狮训练。

items.en: The tigers, which arrived last spring, are in the enclosure on your left.
items.zh: 去年春天到来的老虎，就在你左边的围栏里。

items.en: If it starts to rain, the outdoor animal shows will be moved indoors soon.
items.zh: 如果开始下雨，户外的动物表演将很快移到室内。

items.en: Visitors who bring young children can borrow the free strollers near the main entrance.
items.zh: 带小孩的游客可以在正门附近借用免费的婴儿车。

items.en: Because the panda is resting, please stay quiet when you pass its habitat.
items.zh: 因为熊猫在休息，经过它的场馆时请保持安静。

items.en: When the zoo closes, an announcement that guides you to the exit will play.
items.zh: 闭园时，会播放一则引导你前往出口的广播。
chunks: that guides you to the exit

items.en: The souvenirs that we sell in the gift shop are made by local artists nearby.
items.zh: 我们纪念品店里出售的纪念品由附近的本地艺术家制作。
chunks: that we sell in the gift shop
